value.rationale: Proposition 3.3 is a quantitative stability theorem intended to certify weaving from synthesis closeness. The counterfamily shows that no positive ambient synthesis-distance threshold of the printed form can work: the distance tends to zero while a mixed weave loses the K-frame lower bound completely. The mechanism isolates a structural issue—uncontrolled cancellation from \(R(K)^\perp\)—and yields an immediate sufficient repair.
